messages:
tanya: Quick reminder  Priya's birthday is coming up next Tue. Wanna do something small? office grab-&-go or virtual card + team gift? :tada:
alex: I'm good with either, but FYI Priya said she might be remote that day. if in-office, keep it <10 min around lunch.
maya: please include gf/vegan option if we get food. also maybe individually boxed treats? fewer shared utensils. :pray:
leo: boxed treats sound ideal. no candles pls  allergies & travel safety.
jordan: i'll set up a tally link and collect $4-6 voluntarily. anyone want to be pickup person if we do in-office?
priya: omg you guys this is so sweet! i'm ok with virtual card + group gift since i'll probably be on calls that day, but totally appreciate whatever y'all pick :heart:
tanya: cool, let's do a 24h pulse. react with :cupcake: = in-office grab & go, :envelope_with_heart: = virtual card + gift, :x: = can't/opt out.
events-bot: POLL created: "Priya celebration preference"  Options: 1) Office grab & go 2) Virtual card + gift 3) Opt out. Voting open 24h.
alex: if office wins i can pick up around 11:10 from Little Oven and drop at reception. maya can sign for it?
maya: yep I can sign at reception at 11:15.
leo: tally so far: 5 reactions (3 cupcake, 1 envelope, 1 x).
jordan: sent collection link: https://pay.example/collect/priya-bday. i'll DM reminders. will cap spend at $50 if we go virtual.
tanya: thanks! i'll post final plan here after poll closes and coordinate cards. also can someone help write short message for the card? quick one-liner suggestions welcome :sparkles:
priya: no need to do anything fancy for the message, short & sweet is perfect. thanks for thinking of me <3
alex: suggested card text: "Happy Birthday Priya! Thanks for all the thoughtful help you bring to the team. Hope you have a wonderful day!"
maya: love that. short and sincere. +1
tanya: perfect. closing poll in a few hours, will update with winner and next steps. thanks team :party_popper:
